title: Anthropic Provider: Core Implementation
description:
Implement the full Anthropic Messages API provider in internal/ai/provider/anthropic/. PATTERN LEADER for all providers.

Plan: docs/plans/02-provider-anthropic.md (all sections)

- All tests pass with -race, make check clean
